spacing_and_layout.desktop: 100vw 100vh, overflow-hidden. Background grid created using linear-gradient at 24px or 32px size.
spacing_and_layout.window_borders: 2px solid #333333 (Dark Gray) for high contrast and retro structural feel.
spacing_and_layout.window_shadows: Hard drop-shadow: 4px 4px 0px rgba(51, 51, 51, 0.5) to simulate retro 3D depth.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: Sharp edges (rounded-none) or very subtle (rounded-sm) to match vintage OS aesthetics.
spacing_and_layout.padding: Generous inside windows (p-6) to maintain readability despite retro framing.

windows.logic: Use motion.div with drag attributes. dragConstraints bound to the main desktop ref. dragMomentum={false}.
windows.drag_handle: Restrict dragging to the custom olive green window title bar to avoid interference with inner content.
windows.transitions: Use layout animations with AnimatePresence for open/close and minimize/maximize states. Spring stiffness 300, damping 30.

folder_icons.style: Use react-icons (FcFolder) or Lucide folder icons heavily styled with yellow/gold. Placed on the desktop in a grid layout.
folder_icons.hover: Hover state should slightly scale up (scale-105) and highlight the folder text.

interactive_elements.buttons: Retro inset/outset borders or flat with a sharp 2px dark border and a solid background color (Olive or Coral).

features.terminal: Interactive fake CLI. Maintain history in state. Commands required: help, about, skills, projects, resume, contact, clear.
features.recruiter_mode: A specialized 60-second summary dashboard. High data density, clean charts (Shadcn/Recharts), single-page layout within a window.
features.command_palette: Implemented via cmdk (Ctrl+K). Matches the beige/olive color scheme.
features.visitor_counter: Calendar/Flip-clock style visual on the desktop background.
features.theme_toggle: Retro physical-switch style toggle for dark/light mode (Dark mode reverses Beige/Cream to Deep Charcoal/Olive).
features.skills_progress: Vintage segmented loading bars or progress blocks.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements (folders, window controls, terminal input, command palette items) MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Inject Google Fonts (VT323, IBM Plex Sans, Space Mono) into the global CSS or index.html.
2. Setup Tailwind config with the custom colors defined in this JSON.
3. Build a central Desktop environment component to house the grid, icons, and serve as the boundary constraints for Framer Motion (useRef).
4. Create a reusable Window component (DraggableWindow) using framer-motion. It must support drag, minimize (scale down/hide to taskbar), maximize (fill Desktop), and close actions.
5. The Window header MUST be the drag handle (dragListener on header, drag={true} on window shell) to prevent selecting text from moving the window.
6. Build specific components for each 'App' (Terminal, Resume Viewer, Recruiter Mode, Contact Form).
7. For missing image assets, rely on CSS-styled typography, retro UI patterns, and Lucide/react-icons to maintain the vintage OS illusion.
